title: Urban Development Authority (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW, No. 41 OF 1978.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: - Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, No. 70 of 1979. Amendment of section 9 of the Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978. 2. Section 9 of the Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978 (hereinafter referred to as "the principal enactment" ) is hereby amended in subsection (3) of that section, by the substitution for the word " twenty ", of the words " one hundred ".

body.heading: Amendment of section 11 of the principal enactment
body.raw_text: 3. Section 11 of the principal enactment is hereby amended in subsection (2) of that section, by the substitution for the words " working capital", of the words " working capital or the investment capital ".
